title: Mortgage Pre-Approval Holding Limit and Re-Requests After a Decline
content:
A customer of Larkspur Home Lending holds at most 1 Mortgage Pre-Approval in requested, issued or expired status.

## Desk guidance

**1. Holding limit.** A customer holds at most 1 pre-approval in requested, issued or expired status; a request at a different level replaces the current one, which the borrower withdraws first.

**2. New request after a decline.** A new request within the re-request period after a decline is taken only with new income, asset or credit information. The re-request period is the level's calendar days after a decline before a new request is taken without new information, which is 30 calendar days at every Mortgage Pre-Approval level. The declines counted are the customer's pre-approvals with status declined whose closed date, the date the pre-approval reached declined, falls in the rolling 30 calendar days ending on the current date.

## Statuses counted toward the holding limit

| Status of a pre-approval the customer already has | Counted toward the limit of 1 |
|---|---|
| requested | Yes |
| issued | Yes |
| expired | Yes |
| converted | No |
| declined | No |
| withdrawn | No |

The limit counts the three statuses named in guidance 1 and no others.

## Points of judgement

- **An expired pre-approval still counts.** A customer whose only pre-approval is expired already holds 1 pre-approval in a counted status, exactly as a customer whose pre-approval is issued or still requested.
- **Converted, declined and withdrawn pre-approvals do not count.** None of these statuses is among those the limit counts, so a customer whose earlier pre-approvals are all converted, declined or withdrawn holds none in a counted status.
- **Recent decline, hypothetical dates.** A customer has one declined pre-approval whose closed date is 12 days before the current date. That decline falls inside the rolling 30 calendar days ending on the current date, so a new request from this customer is taken only with new income, asset or credit information.
- **Older decline, hypothetical dates.** A customer's only declined pre-approval has a closed date 75 days before the current date. It falls outside the rolling 30 calendar days ending on the current date, so guidance 2 does not restrict the new request.
